pr.body:
## Summary
- add TP-TO-CANON-000 for safe Task Orchestrator evidence-pack intake
- classify all 26 source DBs while preserving source provenance
- record active dopemux DB adjudication and stop-condition checks

## Validation
- shasum -a 256 /private/tmp/to-all-dbs-20260622T192814Z.tar.gz
- python -m json.tool audit_inputs/task-orchestrator-canon/to-all-dbs-20260622T192814Z/ADJUDICATION_MANIFEST.json
- python -m jsonschema -i task-packets/TP-TO-CANON-000.json docs/03-reference/spec/dopetask/dopetask-canonical-spec.json
- scripts/mcp-wrappers/task-orchestrator-current-stdio.sh --print-resolution
- git diff --check

steps.task: Verify the safe export archive hash, extract it under /tmp, inspect top-level CSV shapes, and confirm EXPORT_ERRORS.csv has zero data rows.
requirements: Stop if export errors are present.
validation: Archive hash and CSV shape evidence captured.

steps.task: Classify all 26 source databases by schema family, content, active/current state, project provenance, stale/empty shell, or recovery-only treatment.
requirements: Preserve source DB slug, path, mtime, counts, schema fingerprint, and treatment.
Do not promote stale, legacy, recovery, or project-specific DB rows into active dopemux current state.
commands: python generation script over /tmp/to-all-dbs-20260622T192814Z safe CSVs
validation: All 26 DBs classified and active dopemux DB is dopemux-mvp-2e346e2084bca021.

steps.task: Write the adjudication report and research evidence without changing runtime code or live Task Orchestrator state.
requirements: Mark the safe export scope and raw note-body limitation.
validation: Generated JSON parses and report records boundary/stop-condition evidence.

steps.task: Validate the task packet and generated artifacts, inspect diff scope, and run precommit on changed files if configured and safe.
requirements: Report all PASS, FAIL, and NOT_RUN results truthfully.
validation: Schema validation and diff checks pass, or blockers are reported.
